Scan the stream from a2+6, counting consecutive words equal to v3 into v4, breaking when the run reaches the max v6 or a differing symbol is read; v74 holds that first differing symbol
When the run is too short (v4 < v7), emit each symbol as a literal: for each of v4 items, pack the code/length pair at +2674/+2676 into the accumulator

Nonzero run: when the run symbol differs from the previous one (v3 != v73) emit the symbol itself via +2674/+2676; in both cases emit the run count v4-3 via the +2738/+2740 table, appending two residual bits to the packed value
Zero run: long runs (v4 > 10) emit the count v4-11 via the +2746/+2748 table with seven appended residual bits; otherwise emit v4-3 via the +2742/+2744 table with three appended residual bits

After each run, reset v4 to zero, record v73 = v3 as the last emitted symbol, and recompute thresholds from the next symbol v74: v6=6/v7=3 when v3 equals v74, v6=7/v7=4 otherwise, and v6=138/v7=3 when v74 is zero
Advance the stream pointer by one word; when the last element (i == 1) was consumed, return a1, otherwise set v3 = v74 and resume scanning the next run
Return the encoder state a1, which carries the accumulator and cursor after all packing
